We find that these galaxies host star formation rates of $27-80$ $M_\odot \ \mathrm{yr^{-1}}$, though $\sim30-40\%$ of the emission may arise from non-star-forming ionization (AGN or shocks), implied by high [FeII]/Pa$α$ in central spaxels. We also find effective $A_{\mathrm{Pa}α}\sim1$ and individual $\sim700$ pc spaxels with $A_{\mathrm{Paα}}\sim2$, implying significant dust obscuration of nebular regions that contribute little to the rest-optical lines. These galaxies are not consistent with total quiescence; the measured star formation rates place these galaxies on or above the main sequence. However, their star formation rates \textit{are} significantly lower ($\sim0.5-1$ dex) than the peak star formation rates inferred from spectrophotometric fitting. We propose that the CO luminous post-starburst phase represents the last gasp of star formation in galaxies on the rapid quenching pathway, and that dust-obscured star formation, outflows, and (speculatively) an uncertain CO-to-H2 conversion reconcile their gas exhaustion with observed timescales of fading.

entries.title: SQuIGG$\vec{L}$E: Ubiquitous Cool Gas Outflows with Large Mass-Loading Factors in $z\sim0.7$ Post-starburst Galaxies
entries.abstract: While recent James Webb Space Telescope studies have highlighted cool gas outflows as an important mechanism for rapid quenching at $z\gtrsim2$, such space-based spectroscopic samples remain limited in size. In this work, we search for and characterize cool gas outflows traced by Fe II $λλ$2586,2600 and Mg II $λλ$2796,2803 absorption in post-starburst galaxies (PSBs) at $0.5<z<0.9$, which are accessible to ground-based spectroscopy. Utilizing the SQuIGG$\vec{L}$E survey containing over 1300 PSBs, we stack spectra in bins of stellar mass, (specific) star formation rate, burst mass, burst mass fraction, and time since quenching. We observe blueshifted line centroids indicative of outflows in all stacks except the one containing galaxies that quenched more than 260 Myr ago. Outflow velocities decline with increasing time since quenching, while showing little correlation with other galaxy properties. The inferred outflows have large mass loading factors of 1 -- 120, maximum velocities above the interstellar medium escape velocities of their host galaxies, and energy and momentum fluxes exceeding those expected from the current star formation. Our results suggest that cool gas outflows are ubiquitous in intermediate-redshift PSBs and are likely relic outflows launched by previous starburst or AGN activity. These outflows have the potential to quench star formation by transporting gas into the galactic halos, consistent with outflows playing an important role in rapid quenching from intermediate to high redshift.

entries.title: A statistical hardness classification of ultraluminous X-ray sources using long-term Swift/XRT monitoring
entries.abstract: We characterize long-term hardness behavior in 29 ultraluminous X-ray sources (ULXs) using over 3500 archival Swift/XRT observations. We classify observations as soft-band dominated, hard-band dominated, or uncertain from the hardness ratio (HR; 1.5--10/0.3--1.5 keV count rates) and its confidence bounds. We derive $f_{\rm soft}$ and $f_{\rm hard}$ and define the Crossing Index (CI) as the fraction of consecutive confidently classified observations on opposite sides of $HR=1$. We analyze these descriptors with rule-based classification and unsupervised hierarchical clustering. The rule-based analysis identifies eight soft-band-dominated, five hard-band-dominated, and 16 mixed-band systems; clustering yields a similar three-group structure. Known or candidate accretor types tend to occupy band-dominated groups, whereas unknown accretors are more common in the mixed-band group. All four sources with reported long-term X-ray modulation discussed in an orbital or super-orbital context are classified as mixed-band. The three-cluster solution is preferred in 25 of 29 leave-one-out trials, while bootstrap tests find the band-dominated groups more stable than the mixed-band group. As the classification uses observed count rates, the groups represent Swift/XRT signatures rather than intrinsic spectral states. Response-folding tests show that modeled HR depends on absorption column density and photon index. Bayesian reanalysis of a representative low-count source reduces CI from 56.3\% to 38.5\% while preserving its mixed-band classification. Random downsampling produces no systematic shift in CI; halving the observations changes median CI by at most $\sim10\%$ across four sources. Larger samples with independent absorption constraints can test links among these observational classes, accretor type, long-term periodic modulation, and other X-ray properties.

entries.title: The Molecular Circumstellar Environments of Red Supergiants in Galactic Open Clusters
entries.abstract: We aim to expand the sample of RSGs with direct measurements of circumstellar gas through millimeter observations of two of the largest coeval RSG populations in the Galaxy: the open clusters RSGC1 and RSGC2. We present an interferometric molecular line study of 28 RSGs in RSGC1 and RSGC2 with ALMA. The primary targeted emission is CO $J=2-1$ and continuum, with additional thermal and maser SiO lines observed for RSGC2 targets. We measure terminal expansion velocities, systemic velocities, emission-region sizes, and provide updated dust models and luminosities using the new long-wavelength constraints. Finally, we perform 1D radiative transfer modeling of CO rotational-line emission to estimate mass-loss rates. We detect $^{12}$CO toward six RSGs in RSGC2 and five in RSGC1. Except for DFK 52, the spatial distribution of all $^{12}$CO emission is relatively compact or unresolved. The obtained mass-loss rates range from $\log(\dot{M}/M_\odot\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1})=-5.5$ to $-3$, but are highly uncertain due to a lack of stringent constraints on the envelope sizes and temperatures. The lower-limit $\dot{M}$-values we obtain are high compared to standard empirical prescriptions and favor dust models assuming a radiatively driven wind. DFK 49 is a clear outlier: its revised luminosity is the lowest in both clusters, yet it harbors a strong wind with $\dot{M}>10^{-5}\,M_\odot\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$. The CO emission regions are much smaller than expected from nearby RSGs and theoretical models, and suggest a unique phase structure for the CSM around RSGs in cluster environments. This work demonstrates the mutual utility of molecular line and dust observations for constraining RSG winds, while highlighting the need for future spatially resolved, multi-tracer observations of RSGC targets to establish the physical structure of their circumstellar environments and improve mass-loss determinations.

Abstract: “We derive exact non-linear solutions to incompressible magnetohydrodynamics in background rotational shear, with large-scale velocity and magnetic fields linear in position (affine form).”

Abstract: “In the solar near-surface shear layer (NSSL), moderate shear permits stable 11-year reversals with poleward speeds of 8-12 m/s and poloidal and toroidal amplitudes of 4-11 G and 2.2-3.8 kG near 1 Mm depth, in reasonable agreement with regional observations.”

Abstract: “This favors a shallow NSSL origin for a local cycle, while leaving open the issue of a global dynamo.”

analysis.method: TRICEPS 样本包含 16 个 z = 4–5 的大质量星系，仅依据明亮的 [CII] 通量（>2 Jy km/s）选取。巡天结合 ALMA band-7 的 [CII] 158 微米谱线及静止系 160 微米连续谱、JWST NIRCam/MIRI 多波段成像，以及 ALMA/VLA 多条 CO 谱线观测；本篇介绍科学目标、样本基本性质和 ALMA band-7 观测。

analysis.result: 在给定模拟参数下，壳层动量分布宇宙线驱动的流不稳定性通过受激阿尔芬波周围的回旋相位聚束达到饱和。采用理想闭合与 Landau 闭合的 FPIC 模拟均复现 PIC 的饱和振幅及该机制，表明非线性 Landau 阻尼（NLLD）不决定此参数下的饱和水平。所有模拟中的宇宙线离子均在阿尔芬波参考系内完全各向同性化，包括完全没有 NLLD 的理想闭合模拟。理想闭合下，计算域尺度增大十倍不改变饱和振幅。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 壳层动量分布宇宙线驱动的流不稳定性如何非线性饱和，以及 NLLD 是否决定饱和水平并且是否为宇宙线离子各向同性化所必需。
analysis.method: 使用全动理学粒子网格（PIC）模拟，并与采用理想闭合和 Landau 闭合的流体粒子网格（FPIC）模拟比较；另在 FPIC 理想闭合下检验计算域尺度增大十倍的影响。
assumptions: 驱动不稳定性的宇宙线采用壳层动量分布。
所报告机制判断对应的模拟参数为 v_A = 0.01c、n_CR/n_i = 0.01。
limits: 结论能否推广到星际介质典型的更低宇宙线密度与更低阿尔芬速度仍是开放问题；摘要称将在后续工作中研究。
citation_leads: Abstract: “Using fully kinetic particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations, we find that the streaming instability driven by CRs with a shell momentum distribution saturates through gyro-phase bunching around driven Alfvén waves.”

Abstract: “Fluid-PIC (FPIC) simulations with both ideal and Landau closures reproduce the PIC saturation amplitude, and the same gyro-phase bunching mechanism, indicating that nonlinear Landau damping (NLLD) does not determine the saturation level at our simulation parameters ($v_{\rm A} = 0.01c$, $n_{\rm CR}/n_i = 0.01$).”

Abstract: “Notably, the CR ions fully isotropize in the Alfvén-wave frame in all simulations, including the FPIC run with an ideal closure in which NLLD is entirely absent, showing that this isotropization does not require NLLD.”

Abstract: “We additionally confirm, using the FPIC ideal closure, that this saturation amplitude is unchanged across a tenfold increase in domain size, indicating that the mechanism is local rather than dependent on domain-scale processes.”

Abstract: “Together, these results indicate that, at least in this regime, NLLD is not the dominant saturation mechanism for the CR streaming instability, in tension with common assumptions built into CR transport models used in galaxy formation and interstellar medium simulations.”
Abstract: “Whether this conclusion extends to the lower CR densities and Alfvén speeds characteristic of the interstellar medium remains an open question that we address in an upcoming work.”
analysis.research_progress: 识别出该参数区间内的回旋相位聚束饱和机制，并通过不同闭合及计算域尺度检验提供支持；结果指出 NLLD 在这一范围内不是主导饱和机制，且离子各向同性化不需要 NLLD，挑战了星系形成与星际介质宇宙线输运模型中的常见假设。

citation_leads: Abstract: “Deciphering the formation channels of the observed binary black hole mergers remains a central open problem in gravitational-wave astronomy.”

Abstract: “Here, we consider the large fraction of massive progenitor stars found in hierarchical triples and investigate black hole mergers driven by gravitational perturbations from tertiary companions.”
Abstract: “Simulations of their dynamics and stellar evolution reproduce key features of the merger population”
Abstract: “a sharp primary mass peak at $m_1\sim10\,\rm M_\odot$ dominating the population”
Abstract: “substantial fractions of systems with large spin-orbit angles within and beyond the peak, matching the skewed distributions of the spin parameters $χ_{\rm eff}$ and $χ_p$”
Abstract: “a mass-ratio distribution favouring equal masses with matching slopes.”

Abstract: “We further predict a sharp decline of mergers near $m_1\sim30\,\rm M_\odot$, coincident with the location of inferred features that may signal another channel dominating the high-mass tail.”

Abstract: “Our models of hierarchical triples demonstrate, for the first time, a formation scenario which simultaneously reproduces the principal properties inferred for the low-mass bulk of binary black hole mergers.”

analysis.reason: 该工作为剥离包层超新星前身和致密双星形成研究提供中等质量氦星的轨道、伴星质量及包层剥离约束，具有实质研究效用。若伴星是活恒星，结果要求高度非保守的包层剥离，可用于检验双星演化假设。但伴星尚未确认为致密天体，论文也未直接测量超新星中心引擎、瞬变辐射或周围介质，因此建议作为前身星与演化渠道方面的重要背景阅读，而非核心高能瞬变必读。
analysis.result: 8颗没有明亮伴星光谱特征的氦星中，5颗检出符合双星运动的显著径向速度变化，3颗未检出。5颗双星的周期约为16小时至301天，偏心率均与零相容；伴星最低质量约0.6–2.9个太阳质量。低质量晚期主序前或年轻主序伴星、低质量剥离星及致密天体仍是可行解释，尚不能确定伴星性质。检出组与未检出组的表面氢丰度不同，提示后者可能涉及不同演化渠道；未检出不能视为确认单星。
analysis.reading_entry: X Summary and Conclusions；随后阅读 V.4 Companion mass constraints from orbits、VII.1 Non-conservative envelope stripping 和 VIII Possible binary companions II: Compact objects。
analysis.problem: 这些氦星的光学隐藏伴星究竟是低质量恒星还是致密天体，以及径向速度观测能否检出双星运动并约束其轨道和伴星质量。
analysis.method: 使用2018–2023年Magellan/MagE多历元光谱，同时拟合多条氦谱线提取径向速度，并通过像素蒙特卡洛重采样估计误差。采用历元间速度差大于20 km/s且显著性大于4的双星判据；用The Joker拒绝采样及MCMC推断轨道，再结合质量函数、氦星质量和各向同性倾角先验约束伴星质量。对活恒星解释，进一步结合系统年龄、V波段光通量及洛希瓣限制。
assumptions: 缺乏直接倾角约束时，采用各向同性的随机轨道倾角分布。
计算致密天体类别的质量区间概率时，采用各向同性倾角和各类别内均匀的质量范围；这些概率以伴星确为致密天体为前提。
limits: 现有观测不能确定伴星是低质量恒星还是致密天体。

Abstract: “Director's Discretionary Time observations on 2026 August 17 added second-epoch NIRCam imaging and a deep NIRSpec prism spectrum.”

Abstract: “Template fits classify SN Helios as a Type II SN, and light-curve comparisons with well-studied local SNe II yield a phase of $27.5\pm2.8$ rest-frame days past B-band maximum.”

Abstract: “Independent cluster lens models magnify the observed image by $μ\approx 10$-20 and predict another image within $\simeq 2$-6 yr, offering a rare opportunity for a time-delay measurement of $H_{0}$ with a source at $z>3$.”
Abstract: “The host galaxy is undetected in deep rest-frame ultraviolet and optical imaging, in emission lines, and in ALMA 2 mm dust continuum, leaving a heavily obscured counterpart unlikely.”
Abstract: “Its de-lensed $M_{\rm UV}\gtrsim -13$ places it far below blank-field limits and adds support to an elevated core-collapse rate per unit star formation in ultra-faint galaxies.”
Abstract: “Its spectrum thus provides an empirical SED template with which high-redshift searches can vet similar dropout candidates.”

Abstract: “Under the assumptions of stationarity and axial symmetry, we derive the explicit expression for the linearized stress-energy tensor of the source and obtain the corresponding metric through a multipole expansion.”
Abstract: “The ensuing solution exhibits a generalized Lense-Thirring structure, with both the gravitoelectric and gravitomagnetic sectors affected by the quantum spin and macroscopic rotation.”
Abstract: “Our work represents an extension of the foundational analysis of Arkuszewski, Kopczy{ń}ski and Ponomariev, which was restricted to the static fluid configuration.”

Abstract: “Here we investigate whether hydrogenated carbonaceous molecular particles can be the carriers of these features.”
Abstract: “Rather than assuming candidate geometries we generate the initial structures using ab initio molecular dynamics simulations and optimize them using density functional theory.”
Abstract: “We then compare the computed emission spectra to JWST NIRSpec and MIRI/MRS observations of Class D sources.”

Abstract: “The structures providing the best agreements contain sizeable domains with defect-bearing aromatics and hydrogenated-aromatics connected by aliphatic bridges, in contrast to the "arophatic" cluster model of isolated two- to three-ring aromatics connected by aliphatic and olefinic bridges.”
Abstract: “As a representative example, we discuss in detail the molecular particle C130H96 (radius of 5.5 A) and compare its computed spectrum to the JWST spectra of IRAS 05110-6616”

Abstract: “The calculated spectra are in qualitative agreement with the observed 3 micron profile, the aliphatic C-H bending bands, the broad 8 micron feature, the 11-14 micron C-H out-of-plane region, and the bands at 16 and 21 microns.”

Abstract: “We hypothesize that UV photo-driven fragmentation of such molecular particles releases aromatics linked by aliphatics, followed by the formation of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons and fullerenes as these objects evolve into planetary nebulae.”

Abstract: “we combine astrometry from Gaia with spectroscopic data from available surveys to comprehensively analyze the stream's chemical and dynamical properties.”

analysis.reading_entry: 摘要
analysis.problem: 研究大质量年轻恒星体 G28.28-0.36 周围氰基多炔及复杂有机分子的发射和化学特征，考察热碳链化学机制是否能够解释其氰基多炔的产生。
analysis.method: 使用 ALMA Band 3 分子发射谱线数据，分析氰基多炔和复杂有机分子的探测及空间分布，并由 CH3CN 推导激发温度。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We present molecular emission line data from the massive young stellar object (MYSO) G28.28-0.36 (G28.28) obtained with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array Band 3.”
Abstract: “Cyanopolyynes (HC$_3$N and HC$_5$N) and three complex organic molecules (COMs; CH$_3$OH, CH$_3$CN, and CH$_3$CHO) are detected from the MYSO G28.28.”
Abstract: “The HC$_5$N emission is coincident with the dust continuum peak, where an excitation temperature of 100 K is derived from CH$_3$CN.”
Abstract: “These results suggest that the Hot Carbon Chain Chemistry (HCCC) mechanism produces cyanopolyynes in the hot region around G28.28.”
Abstract: “We find that G28.28 exhibits a unique chemical feature: cyanopolyynes are abundant, but COMs are deficient, unlike the other MYSOs studied previously.”
Abstract: “G28.28 is the first HCCC source identified so far.”
analysis.research_progress: 作者报告 G28.28 是迄今首个被识别的热碳链化学（HCCC）源，其氰基多炔丰富而复杂有机分子不足的特征不同于此前研究的其他大质量年轻恒星体。

analysis.result: 光变与光谱分析支持一个大型、不对称且可能进动的吸积盘；多普勒层析显示发射来自盘外围的不对称分布，而非紧致点源。在采用距离 2409 pc 时，供体质量估计约为 0.38 Ms，但存在显著不确定性。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 研究 V630 Cassiopeiae 的光变行为、吸积盘发射结构、供体质量及能够解释其性质的双星演化序列。
analysis.method: 结合新光谱观测、TESS 高分辨率测光及 GAIA 距离数据，开展光度和光谱分析、多普勒层析，并使用包含 CARB 磁制动处方的 MESA 进行双星演化模拟。
assumptions: 供体质量估计采用距离 2409 pc。
limits: 盘外围发射的不对称分布使径向速度解释复杂化，限制其用于精确确定质量。
供体质量估计具有与距离及其他系统因素相关的显著不确定性。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We present a comprehensive review of V630 Cassiopeiae, which is a very long-period cataclysmic variable.”

Abstract: “Based on new observations combining spectroscopy and high-resolution photometry provided by TESS and precise distance data from GAIA, we confirm and extend previously described characteristics.”

Abstract: “The spectroscopy reveals complex Ha line profiles, with dual components and an emission distribution that suggests a large, asymmetric, and possibly precessing disk, rather than a classic shock structure in the matter-flow impact region.”

Abstract: “Doppler tomography indicates that the emission originates at the periphery of the disk, distributed in an asymmetric pattern rather than a compact point, complicating the interpretation of radial velocities and limiting their use for accurately determining masses.”

Abstract: “Through photometric and spectroscopic analysis, we established a donor mass estimate with an approximate value of 0.38 Ms at the adopted distance of 2409 pc, with significant uncertainty related to distance and other systematic factors.”

Abstract: “Finally, using the parameters of V630 Cas, binary evolution simulations were conducted with MESA incorporating CARB magnetic braking prescription to identify an evolutionary sequence that explains its properties.”
analysis.research_progress: 基于新光谱、TESS 测光和 GAIA 距离数据，确认并扩展此前描述的性质；给出供体质量估计，并开展包含 CARB 磁制动处方的双星演化模拟。

analysis.result: 获得19个长周期单线双星候选的贝叶斯开普勒轨道解，周期约为30–1500天。其中两个系统的伴星最低质量均超过1个太阳质量，光谱和光学至红外测光未检测到次星光贡献，被作者列为样本中最强的致密天体候选；另有5个中等优先级和12个较低优先级后随观测目标。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 如何在非相互作用双星中识别休眠致密天体，以约束隐藏的恒星遗骸种群。
analysis.method: 联合 Gaia DR3 天体测量与 LAMOST DR13 多历元中分辨率光谱，从 RUWE 偏高的源出发，要求至少5个光谱历元且径向速度峰峰变化超过20 km/s；经过径向速度提取、轨道拟合和筛选，获得贝叶斯开普勒轨道解，并用多波段光谱能量分布拟合约束可见恒星及检验主序伴星的预期光度。
assumptions: 评估不可见伴星预期光度时采用其为主序星的假设。
limits: 最强候选尚未确认为致密天体，仍需进一步观测，以区分大质量白矮星或中子星、暗弱恒星伴星及未分辨的层级系统。
citation_leads: Abstract: “Identifying dormant compact objects in non-interacting binaries is crucial for constraining the hidden population of stellar remnants.”
Abstract: “We present a systematic search for long-period compact-object candidates by combining Gaia DR3 astrometry with multi-epoch LAMOST DR13 medium-resolution spectroscopy.”
Abstract: “Starting from sources with elevated RUWE values, we required at least five LAMOST spectroscopic epochs and peak-to-peak RV variations exceeding 20 km/s.”

Abstract: “After RV extraction, orbital fitting, and subsequent screening, we obtained Bayesian Keplerian orbital solutions for 19 long-period single-lined binary candidates, with periods spanning approximately 30-1500 days.”
Abstract: “Multi-wavelength spectral energy distribution fitting was used to constrain the visible stars and evaluate the expected luminosities of unseen companions under a main-sequence assumption.”
Abstract: “Two systems are identified as the highest-priority compact-object candidates in our sample, each with a minimum companion mass exceeding 1 solar mass.”

Abstract: “Their spectra and optical-to-infrared photometry show no detectable secondary-light contribution, although such a contribution would be expected if the unseen companions were normal main-sequence stars.”

Abstract: “These systems therefore represent the strongest compact-object candidates in our sample, although further observations are required to distinguish massive white dwarfs or neutron stars from faint stellar companions or unresolved hierarchical systems.”
Abstract: “We also identify five intermediate-priority and 12 lower-priority systems for follow-up spectroscopy, ultraviolet imaging, and future astrometric constraints.”
analysis.research_progress: 通过联合 Gaia DR3 与 LAMOST DR13 数据建立了19个长周期单线双星候选的轨道解，并依据伴星最低质量及次星光贡献检验形成分级后随观测样本。

analysis.reason: 研究对象是接触食双星，重点为星斑、第三光、轨道周期变化及第三天体影响；给定摘要未显示其与 FRB/PRS 环境、超新星中心引擎、激波破越、周星介质相互作用或致密天体高能观测等研究方向存在实质联系。
analysis.result: BS Cas 被建模为质量较大成员温度较低的接触双星，质量比为 2.515，填充因子为 32.3%。长期测光变化被归因于演化星斑和第三光贡献变化。食时变化显示轨道周期以 -2.305 × 10^-7 days yr^-1 的速率长期减小，并存在被解释为第三天体光行时效应的 18.376 年调制。TESS 主、次极小食时的反相关变化可能源于高纬度星斑的差异自转。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 研究 BS Cas 长期光变曲线形状及食时变化的成因，并确定其双星参数、磁活动与额外成员的作用。
analysis.method: 结合 22 年多站点光变曲线与 2 年高分辨率光谱，利用展宽函数轮廓提取双线径向速度曲线，联合拟合 BVR 光变曲线和径向速度，进行多历元建模及食时变化分析。
citation_leads: Abstract: “These results suggest that BS Cas is a physically complex contact binary in which long-term photometric and eclipse-timing variations reflect multiple processes, including magnetic activity and the influence of a third body.”
Abstract: “We present a comprehensive photometric and spectroscopic analysis of the contact eclipsing binary BS Cas, based on 22-yr multi-site light curves and 2-yr high-resolution spectra.”
Abstract: “The first double-lined radial-velocity (RV) curves of BS Cas are derived from the spectra using broadening-function (BF) profiles.”
Abstract: “Sharp peaks absent from the 2018 BFs appear in the 2020 BFs, suggesting an additional component along the same line of sight as BS Cas.”

Abstract: “Simultaneous modeling of the BVR light curves and the RVs shows that BS Cas is a contact binary in which the more massive component is cooler than its less massive companion, with a mass ratio of 2.515 and a fill-out factor of 32.3%.”
Abstract: “Multi-epoch modeling suggests that the long-term photometric variations arise from evolving starspots and changes in the third-light contribution.”

Abstract: “The eclipse-timing variation diagram confirms a secular orbital period decrease at a rate of $-2.305 \times 10^{-7}~\mathrm{days\,yr^{-1}}$ consistent with angular momentum loss and mass transfer, along with an 18.376-yr modulation interpreted as a light-travel-time effect from a third body.”
Abstract: “The TESS timings reveal anti-correlated variations between the primary and secondary minima that appear to result from differential rotation of high-latitude starspots.”
analysis.research_progress: 首次获得 BS Cas 的双线径向速度曲线；2020 年展宽函数中出现而 2018 年没有的尖峰提示同一视线方向上存在额外成员，并通过长期测光和食时分析区分星斑、第三光及第三天体可能产生的影响。

analysis.reason: 本文研究活动星系核 Ark 564 的长期 X 射线能谱变化及软超额起源，重点是吸积流—日冕系统中的暖康普顿化与相对论反射模型。给定摘要未呈现与 FRB/PRS 环境、超新星中心引擎、激波破越、周星介质相互作用或致密天体高能瞬变等研究方向的实质联系，因此在摘要筛选阶段跳过。
analysis.result: 软、硬 X 射线均显著变化且呈强正相关；简单吸收幂律模型不足以描述能谱。加入暖康普顿化成分可改善拟合，并为软超额提供一致解释，但现有数据无法可靠判断相对论反射是否是更优或物理上更合适的解释。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: Ark 564 的长期 X 射线能谱变化及软超额的物理起源，尤其是暖康普顿化与相对论反射解释的区分。
analysis.method: 使用跨越十六年的 Swift/XRT 观测进行系统能谱研究和多模型拟合，检验吸收幂律、暖康普顿化成分，并对代表性观测应用相对论反射模型。
limits: Swift/XRT 的能谱分辨率中等且高能覆盖有限，现有数据不足以可靠判定反射模型是否更优或物理上更合适。
需要更深的宽波段观测，才能明确区分竞争模型并全面刻画该源的长期 X 射线能谱变化。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We present a systematic spectral study of the X-ray emission from the Narrow- Line Seyfert 1 (NLS1) galaxy Ark 564 using Swift/XRT observations spanning sixteen years.”
Abstract: “The source exhibits significant variability in both the soft and hard X-ray bands, along with a strong positive correlation between them”
Abstract: “A simple absorbed power-law model is statistically insufficient to describe the spectra, confirming the presence of an additional soft component.”
Abstract: “To investigate the origin of the soft excess, we performed multi-model spectral fitting.”
Abstract: “Incor- porating a warm Comptonization component yields a statistically improved fit”

Abstract: “We also applied a relativistic reflection model to representative observations; however, given the moderate spectral resolution and limited high-energy coverage of Swift/XRT, the current data do not allow us to robustly determine whether reflection provides a superior or physically preferred description.”
Abstract: “Our results indicate that warm Comptonization offers a consistent explanation for the observed soft excess in Ark 564 within the limitations of the available data”
Abstract: “deeper broadband observations are required to defini- tively distinguish between competing models and comprehensively characterise the long-term X-ray spectral variability of the source”
analysis.research_progress: 基于十六年 Swift/XRT 观测的系统能谱研究，表明暖康普顿化在现有数据限制下可一致解释 Ark 564 的软超额，同时明确了区分竞争模型所需的进一步观测。

analysis.reason: 研究主题是星际天体的挥发物组成及其母恒星金属丰度，旨在用彗星挥发物产率追溯来源系统。摘要未呈现与 FRB/PRS、高能瞬变中心引擎、激波及周星介质、相对论喷流、中微子或致密天体高能观测的实质联系；所述光解产物示踪也不属于研究组关注的光电离与色散测量问题。
analysis.result: 模型预测星际天体的组成在不同母恒星之间显著变化，尤其是氨丰度与母恒星金属丰度强相关，高金属丰度恒星产生富氨星际天体。作者推断 2I/Borisov 的母恒星接近太阳金属丰度（-0.4≲[Fe/H]≲0.3），3I/ATLAS 的母恒星金属丰度较低（-0.8≲[Fe/H]≲0.0）。两者的产率暗示其 CO 和 N₂ 等超挥发物被困在其他较低挥发性的冰中。
analysis.reading_entry: 摘要
analysis.problem: 星际天体中常见彗星挥发物的丰度如何随母恒星性质变化，以及能否利用可观测产率追溯其来源系统。
analysis.method: 将化学分配模型与 APOGEE DR17 的恒星元素丰度样本结合，预测星际天体中常见彗星挥发物的丰度。
citation_leads: Abstract: “As physical samples of distant planetary systems, the compositions of interstellar objects (ISOs) should correlate with the properties of their diverse parent stars.”
Abstract: “We combine a chemical partition model with a sample of stellar elemental abundances from APOGEE DR17 to predict the abundances of commonly-observed cometary volatiles in ISOs.”
Abstract: “We find that the compositions of ISOs vary significantly between different stars.”
Abstract: “In particular, we predict a strong correlation between an ISO's ammonia abundance and its parent star's metallicity: high-metallicity stars will create ISOs rich in ammonia.”
Abstract: “This suggests the production rates of NH$_3$'s photolytic daughter products are an ideal observational tracer for the origins of ISOs.”

Abstract: “We infer that 2I/Borisov formed around a star of near-solar metallicity ($-0.4\lesssim[\mathrm{Fe}/\mathrm{H}]\lesssim0.3$), and corroborate the velocity- and isotope-based inferences that 3I/ATLAS formed around a lower-metallicity star ($-0.8\lesssim[\mathrm{Fe}/\mathrm{H}]\lesssim0.0$).”
Abstract: “The production rates of 2I and 3I imply both only contain hypervolatiles such as CO and N$_2$ that are trapped in other less-volatile ices, similar to typical Solar System comets.”
Abstract: “Our predictions provide context for future ISO discoveries, opening a path to link the properties of their origin systems to observable production rates.”
analysis.research_progress: 提出利用 NH₃ 光解子产物的产率示踪星际天体来源，并通过组成推断支持了既有基于速度和同位素的 3I/ATLAS 低金属丰度来源判断，为未来星际天体发现提供来源系统性质与可观测产率之间的联系。

analysis.reason: 本文研究低质量高红移星系内周星系介质的吸收线、运动学和热性质。虽然涉及电离态与气体加热，但摘要未建立与 FRB/PRS 环境、瞬变周星介质、超新星中心引擎、相对论喷流或致密天体高能观测的实质联系，因此在本组摘要筛选中跳过。
analysis.result: 两个星系晕均未检出低电离金属吸收，却普遍检出中、高电离态吸收；每个晕具有至少七个吸收分量，且未发现明确不受引力束缚的气体。在分析热性质的十个分量中，六个的温度与河外紫外背景加热一致，中位 log(T/K)=4.0，其余分量为 log(T/K)=4.6–5.1 的短寿命中温气体，需要额外加热或快速补充。吸收体内部湍流速度均为亚声速，而其穿过星系晕的运动可能为超声速。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 低质量 z≈2.3 星系内周星系介质的电离态、运动学复杂性、气体束缚状态和热性质，以及这些性质如何随恒星质量变化。
analysis.method: 分析两个恒星质量 log(M*/M☉)≤9、与背景类星体投影距离≤50 kpc 的星系；使用 Keck/KCWI 和 Keck/MOSFIRE 探测及表征星系，并利用背景类星体的 Keck/HIRES 光谱分析周星系介质吸收及部分吸收分量的热性质。
limits: 星系样本仅有两个。
热性质分析仅覆盖部分周星系介质吸收分量，共十个。
关于周星系介质性质随恒星质量变化的结论仅表述为提示，而非确定结论。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We present results from an extension to the Keck Baryonic Structure Survey (KBSS) that focuses on the Inner Circumgalactic Medium (CGM) of QSO Line Of Sight Emitting galaxies at z$\sim$2.3 (InCLOSE).”
Abstract: “We analyze two low-mass galaxies $\log{(\rm{M_*} / \rm{M_\odot})} \leq 9$”
Abstract: “One galaxy is detected as a bright Lyman- Emitter with Keck/KCWI (confirmed with follow-up Keck/MOSFIRE spectra), and the other as a serendipitous line emitter with Keck/MOSFIRE.”

Abstract: “Analysis of their CGM absorption as seen with Keck/HIRES spectra of the background QSOs shows no detections of low-ionization metal absorption (low-ions; e.g., Si II), ubiquitous detections of intermediate- (e.g., C IV) and high-ions (O VI), kinematically complex absorption ($\geq$7 components per galaxy halo)”
Abstract: “no unambiguously unbound gas is detected in either galaxy halo.”

Abstract: “We analyze the thermal properties of a subset of CGM components, finding that the majority (6/10) have temperatures consistent with heating from the metagalactic UV background ($\log{(T/\rm{K})_{\mathrm{med}}}=4.0$) while the remainder possess short-lived, intermediate temperature gas that would require additional heating or rapid replenishment ($4.6 \leq \log{(T/\rm{K})} \leq 5.1$)”
Abstract: “their internal (turbulent) velocities are all subsonic, while their motions through the halo are likely supersonic.”
Abstract: “These results hint that the z2.3 CGM changes with stellar mass in terms of kinematic complexity and unbound gas fraction, while thermal properties remain similar.”
analysis.research_progress: 扩展 KBSS 对低质量 z≈2.3 星系内周星系介质的观测，提供两个近类星体视线星系晕的详细吸收与热性质分析；结果提示运动学复杂性和不受束缚气体比例可能随恒星质量变化，而热性质相似。

analysis.result: 线性拍频中，正弦次级信号只产生一个额外峰；非正弦次级信号产生谐波序列，其与主振荡谐波的频率间隔随阶数增加。二次耦合产生 nf_0+lf_B 项，其振幅和相位遵循移位谐波与组合关系。在一般非线性阶次下，耦合与调制占据相同频率网格，但摘要指出仍可利用观测关系加以辨识。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 脉动恒星光变曲线中的侧峰或多重峰可由调制、线性拍频或近频振荡的非线性耦合产生；论文研究如何在频率模式重叠时区分这些解释。
analysis.method: 建立统一的解析傅里叶描述，将信号表示为主导的非正弦振荡及一个或多个近频次级振荡，推导线性叠加、二次耦合及一般非线性耦合的频率、复振幅和相位；用人工光变曲线示范，并在 freqdiag 工具中实现模型比较和侧峰振幅递进的层级检验。
assumptions: 信号表示为一个主导的非正弦振荡，加上一个或多个频率与其接近的次级振荡。
limits: 在一般非线性阶次下，耦合与调制占据相同频率网格，频率位置本身不能区分二者。
citation_leads: Abstract: “The formalism provides a practical framework for interpreting Blazhko-like RRc stars, HADS variables, and other pulsating stars in which modulation and coupling are difficult to separate observationally.”
Abstract: “Such structures are often attributed to modulation, although linear beating and the non-linear coupling of close oscillations can also produce similar patterns.”
Abstract: “We develop a unified analytical Fourier description of these alternatives and identify observational relations that retain discriminatory power when their frequency patterns overlap.”

Abstract: “We represent the signal as a dominant, non-sinusoidal oscillation plus one or more secondary oscillations close to it, and analytically derive the frequencies, complex amplitudes, and phases resulting from linear superposition, quadratic and general non-linear coupling.”
Abstract: “We also illustrate the calculated phenomena using artificial light curves.”

Abstract: “We implement the resulting tests in a diagnostic tool "freqdiag", which compares modulation with primary--secondary quadratic coupling models anchored to either the higher- or lower-frequency side peak, using the same normalized complex amplitudes, and supplements the fit with hierarchical tests of side-peak amplitude progression.”

Abstract: “A sinusoidal secondary signal produces only one additional peak in the linear-beating case, whereas a non-sinusoidal secondary signal produces a harmonic sequence, whose separation from the primary harmonics increases with order.”
Abstract: “Quadratic coupling produces terms $nf_0+lf_B$, but their amplitudes and phases follow shifted-harmonic and combination relations.”
Abstract: “At general non-linear order, coupling and modulation occupy the same frequency grid.”
analysis.research_progress: 提出针对调制、线性拍频和非线性耦合的统一解析傅里叶框架，识别频率模式重叠时仍具辨识力的观测关系，并将相应检验实现于 freqdiag 诊断工具。

analysis.result: 作者报告，卷积自编码器能够在玩具模型、模拟暗物质观测及两例 H.E.S.S. 实际观测中重建信号和背景并去噪。单模型基准玩具案例的整体相对差异为 3.55%，KL 散度为 0.0012；10 模型集成提供模型间离散度对应的 68% 包含带。多源重叠案例能够恢复总体形态，但不能完全恢复峰间谷底；实际观测的比较基准是传统提取方法，而非已知真值。上述表现依据正文报告，未独立检查图像或数据。
analysis.reading_entry: H.E.S.S. Public Data Release
analysis.problem: 如何从带有泊松噪声、可能具有低信号背景比且包含多个重叠源的甚高能伽马射线计数数据中，提取信号与背景的空间分布及能谱，而不预先指定信号源数量或背景主导区域。
analysis.method: 将空间—能量三维计数立方体输入深度二维卷积变分自编码器，各能量箱作为独立通道；共享编码器连接两个解码头，分别预测去噪后的信号与背景。训练最小化各目标分量与重建输出之间的均方误差，本文将 KL 和稀疏性惩罚均设为零。使用10个不同随机初始化的模型构成集成，平均输出并给出模型间的68%包含带；归一化输出的相对尺度通过掩膜、两阶段最小二乘投影和迭代拟合恢复。
assumptions: 计数立方体被视为底层平均场的一次泊松实现。
信号与背景分量的空间分布和能量分布可分解为不相关因子的乘积；多信号分量通过求和构成总场。
本文双解码头分别针对感兴趣信号和假定的弥散背景。
limits: 方法高度依赖覆盖待处理情景的大量训练数据及足够训练时间；不能将无须预先指定源数或背景区域理解为无训练先验。
实际 H.E.S.S. 测试的训练样本由目标观测模板经谱形、信号背景比和噪声变换生成。虽然原始观测被排除于训练集，仍不能据此确认对独立源形态或独立观测的泛化能力。
实际观测没有已知真值；空间和能谱输出分别与 Ring Background 和 Multiple OFF 方法所得模型比较，不能据此确认逐像素真实分量被完全恢复。
归一化网络输出不直接给出信号背景比，需要后处理重组合；正文将无背景主导区域、很低信号背景比或重组合退化解列为未来需增强稳健性的情景。
多源重叠案例存在局部形态重建偏差；集成包含带反映模型输出之间的离散度，正文未建立其对完整观测误差的覆盖校准。

Abstract: “We represent distribution functions using multiple candidate models of different complexity and perform inference on synthetic spectra generated from known non-Maxwellian distribution functions.”

analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 年轻恒星体的恒星活动如何影响其周围多环芳香烃（PAHs）的加工及光谱特征。
analysis.method: 分析 10 个 YSO 的 AKARI 近红外（2.6–4.4 μm）长缝光谱，通过光谱拟合研究 3.3 μm 芳香族特征和 3.4–3.6 μm 脂肪族特征，并考察相关光谱特征的变化与关联。
limits: PAHs 经 YSO 活动产生的高能粒子辐照转化为纳米金刚石，仅被表述为与观测可能一致的暂定情景，而非已证实机制。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We investigate the processing of the circumstellar polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) associated with young stellar objects (YSOs) through their stellar activities.”

Abstract: “We analyze the AKARI near-infrared (2.6$-$4.4 $μ$m) long-slit spectral data of 10 YSOs, focusing on the aromatic feature at a wavelength of 3.3 $μ$m and the aliphatic features at 3.4$-$3.6 $μ$m.”

Abstract: “The spectral fitting results show large variations from target to target in the flux ratio of the aliphatic to aromatic features, the shape of the aliphatic feature profile, and the central wavelength of the aromatic feature.”

Abstract: “In particular, HD 97048 and Elias 1 show strong aliphatic features at wavelengths longer than 3.5 $μ$m, which is consistent with the hydrogenated nanodiamond features reported in previous studies.”

Abstract: “In addition, correlation is observed between the variations of the H$_2$O and CO$_2$ ice features and the aliphatic feature profiles, suggesting connection between the formation of CO$_2$ ice and the processing of aliphatic hydrocarbons.”
Abstract: “Finally, we find a significant correlation between the variations in the central wavelength of the aromatic feature and the shape of the aliphatic feature profile.”
Abstract: “These findings may be consistent with a tentative scenario in which circumstellar PAHs are converted to nanodiamonds through irradiation by high-energy particles produced by YSO activity.”

analysis.problem: 如何在核星团与中心超大质量黑洞的自洽动力学模型中，更合理地描述潮汐瓦解后恒星碎片的质量吸积及其对黑洞增长的贡献。

assumptions: 新部分质量吸积模型将加入超大质量黑洞的质量设为被瓦解恒星轨道偏心率与穿透因子的函数。

citation_leads: Abstract: “Our work aims to improve the theoretical framework for understanding the mass accretion of stellar debris following tidal disruption events (TDEs) through numerical simulations.”

Abstract: “We perform direct N-body simulations of an NSC with a central SMBH embedded in a fully self-consistent dynamical model to test a new TDE accretion prescription in a set of pilot simulations.”
Abstract: “The previous TDE prescription used a fixed accretion radius and assumed that the entire stellar mass was accreted after disruption.”
Abstract: “In the new partial-mass accretion model, the mass added to the SMBH depends on the orbital eccentricity and penetration factor of the disrupted star.”

Abstract: “We find that most TDEs involving main-sequence stars are marginally eccentric or marginally hyperbolic and contribute approximately half of the stellar mass to SMBH growth, consistent with recent hydrodynamical simulations.”
Abstract: “In all simulated models, the TDE-driven mass accretion rate exhibits an early peak followed by a rapid decline.”
Abstract: “Models with higher initial SMBH masses exhibit a faster decline in the accretion rate, consistent with more rapid loss-cone depletion and inefficient replenishment”

Abstract: “We have performed JWST spectroscopy at higher resolution (R~1000) on one of the brown dwarfs in IC 348, LRL 11001 (~6 MJup).”

Abstract: “In addition, the spectrum contains emission lines at 3.324 and 3.333um, which we attribute to Q branches of CH4 hot bands between the octad and dyad regions (primarily nu3+nu4->nu4) and the tetradecad and pentad regions.”

analysis.reading_entry: 摘要
analysis.problem: HCN(1-0) 示踪的致密气体与恒星形成之间是否存在普适线性关系，以及银河系致密团块能否解释河外观测的 IR–HCN 关系。
analysis.method: 分析 343 个银河系团块的 HCN(1-0) 与 IR 光度关系，覆盖静止、原恒星、年轻恒星体和 HII 区等演化阶段，并比较完整样本与分阶段样本；通过对 Hi-GAL 源的总辐射光度和团块质量进行积分，估算致密团块贡献的银河系总 IR 与 HCN 光度。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We examine the relation between star formation and dense gas, traced by HCN(1-0), using a sample of 343 Galactic clumps”
Abstract: “Earlier Galactic studies, based primarily on luminous HII regions, reported a linear correlation between infrared (IR) and HCN luminosities”
Abstract: “Our larger evolutionary sample yields a significantly steeper slope of $1.80\pm0.08$, inconsistent with extragalactic trends.”
Abstract: “each of the star-forming evolutionary stages individually has a shallower slope ($\sim$1.2) than that of the full sample, with quiescent clumps showing no correlation.”
Abstract: “We estimate the Milky Way's total IR and HCN luminosities from dense clumps by integrating the bolometric luminosities and clump masses of Hi-GAL sources.”
Abstract: “Only $\sim$5-25 per cent of Galactic HCN luminosity arises from dense clumps”
Abstract: “dense clumps contribute only $\sim$2-3 per cent of the Milky Way's IR luminosity”

Abstract: “the observed linear relation in nearby galaxies reflects a nearly constant star formation efficiency averaged over large areas and long timescales, rather than a direct link between SFR and dense gas mass.”
analysis.research_progress: 相较于此前主要基于明亮 HII 区的银河系研究，本文扩大了演化阶段覆盖，发现完整样本的关系更陡、分阶段关系较浅，并估算致密团块对银河系 HCN 与 IR 总光度的贡献，从而质疑将河外线性关系直接解释为致密气体尺度上的普适恒星形成律。

citation_leads: Abstract: “a modular Python interface that wraps the official ESO esorex recipes behind a single, user-friendly matisse command”

Abstract: “the reduction relies on command-line calls to esorex, hand-edited set-of-files (SOF) and configuration files, and manual iterations that are difficult to automate, reproduce, or integrate into modern Python workflows.”
Abstract: “It automates discovery, reduction, calibration, and inspection of the data, and ships as a tested, open-source package built on industry-standard practices.”

Abstract: “science-grade improvements developed over seven years of MATISSE operations: visibility- and photometry-factor (V-factor and P-factor) corrections derived from the GRAVITY fringe tracker to mitigate residual visibility losses, per-baseline data filtering, beam-commuting-device (BCD) "magic-number" corrections, and an absolute spectrophotometric flux calibration using state-of-the-art reference spectra.”

analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 通过比较猎户座棒、NGC7023 和马头星云的 H2 发射，约束解离前沿的物理结构，并研究不同区域紫外辐射场和气体密度的影响。
analysis.method: 分析 JWST 探测到的 H2 旋转及振转谱线，包括空间形态、谱线间空间偏移和旋转激发；使用 H2 振转谱线及 0-0 S(3) 谱线估计视场内的视消光。
limits: 复杂的三维几何结构使视场内 H2 发射主要由薄的紫外照射层主导，因此 H2 不能可靠追踪更深、更冷分子层中的气体温度。
仅凭 H2 发射不足以追踪光解离区可能存在的温度和密度梯度，需要结合其他示踪物。
citation_leads: Abstract: “Our goal is to analyze H2 line emission detected with JWST in several PDRs (the Orion Bar, NGC7023, and the Horsehead Nebula) to constrain the physical structure of dissociation front, and compare the impact of the ultraviolet field and the gas density across different regions.”
Abstract: “The analysis of H2 spatial morphology reveals similar filamentary structures across all regions.”
Abstract: “Spatial shifts between H2 lines (0.5") are observed and linked to differences in excitation mechanisms (thermalized vs FUV-pumped lines) and the temperature gradient.”
Abstract: “Despite differences in incident irradiation conditions, analysis of H2 rotational excitation yields high gas temperatures that are similar across the three PDRs.”
Abstract: “However, it is surprising for less excited PDRs like the Horsehead Nebula.”
Abstract: “OPRs in the rotational and rovibrational levels differ across the three PDRs.”

Abstract: “We also used H2 rovibrational lines and the 0-0 S(3) line to estimate the visual extinction across the field of view, yielding markedly different results that constrain both the geometry and the grain composition.”

Abstract: “Due to the complex 3D geometry, H2 emission is observed throughout the FOV and is dominated by the thin UV illuminated layer, making H2 an unreliable tracer of gas temperature in deeper and coolers molecular layers of the PDR.”
Abstract: “Therefore, H2 emission is not sufficient to trace the possible temperature and density gradient across PDRs and must therefore be associated with other tracers.”
analysis.research_progress: 基于 JWST 对三个光解离区的比较，报告不同辐照条件下相近的高 H2 旋转激发温度，特别指出较低激发的马头星云也出现这一结果；同时明确了 H2 发射作为深层冷分子气体温度及整体温度、密度梯度示踪物的局限。

analysis.reading_entry: 摘要
analysis.problem: 解释 S 星团年轻恒星的起源，以及其双星比例为何显著低于银河场中的大质量恒星。
analysis.method: 利用 K 振幅数据估计观测双星比例，并通过动力学建模研究恒星双星与 Sgr A* 的相互作用，比较理论双星比例及其距离依赖与观测约束。
assumptions: 在 S 星团原位形成情景下研究恒星双星与 Sgr A* 的动力学相互作用。
citation_leads: Abstract: “These stars are predominantly B-type stars, but their origin remains uncertain.”
Abstract: “Unlike massive stars in the Galactic field, which exhibit a binary fraction of about $70\%$, those in the S cluster show a significantly lower fraction.”
Abstract: “We show that the binary deficit arises naturally from dynamical interactions between stellar binaries and Sgr A* in an in situ formation scenario.”
Abstract: “Using K-amplitude data, we derived an observational binary fraction of $f_{\mathrm{obs}} = 0.43 \pm 0.09$ for the S-cluster stars.”

Abstract: “Our dynamical modelling predicts that interactions with Sgr A* cause $18\%$ of the binaries to merge, $20\%$ to be disrupted, and $62\%$ to survive, yielding a theoretical binary fraction of $f_{\mathrm{theo}} = 0.38 \pm 0.10$.”
Abstract: “The predicted binary fraction with distance from Sgr A* is also consistent with independent observational constraints.”

Abstract: “These results show that the decline in binarity towards the Galactic centre is driven by stronger tidal forces, and they support an in situ origin of the S cluster in the same event that produced the Fermi bubbles.”

analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 高 CO 光度、在静止系 UV–光学波段看似宁静的后星暴星系，其瞬时恒星形成率是多少，是否仍有被尘埃遮蔽的活跃恒星形成？
analysis.method: 对 SQuIGG⃗LE 巡天中 CO 光度最高的三个大质量星系进行 JWST/NIRSpec G395M/170LP 积分视场光谱观测，空间分辨 Paα、Brγ 和 Brβ，以绘制尘埃校正后的恒星形成率分布。
limits: 约 30–40% 的发射可能来自非恒星形成电离，摘要依据中心空间像素的高 [FeII]/Paα 提出这一可能性。
CO-to-H2 转换的不确定性在解释气体耗尽与衰减时标时仅被作为推测性因素提出。
citation_leads: Abstract: “One of the fundamental uncertainties in the study of galaxies at the interface between star formation and quiescence--post-starburst galaxies--is their instantaneous star formation rate.”

Abstract: “Here, we present JWST/NIRSpec G395M/170LP integral field spectroscopy of the three most CO-luminous massive galaxies in the SQuIGG$\vec{L}$E survey, spatially resolving Pa$α$/Br$γ$/Br$β$ to map the dust-corrected star formation rate.”

Abstract: “We find that these galaxies host star formation rates of $27-80$ $M_\odot \ \mathrm{yr^{-1}}$, though $\sim30-40\%$ of the emission may arise from non-star-forming ionization (AGN or shocks), implied by high [FeII]/Pa$α$ in central spaxels.”

Abstract: “We also find effective $A_{\mathrm{Pa}α}\sim1$ and individual $\sim700$ pc spaxels with $A_{\mathrm{Paα}}\sim2$, implying significant dust obscuration of nebular regions that contribute little to the rest-optical lines.”
Abstract: “These galaxies are not consistent with total quiescence; the measured star formation rates place these galaxies on or above the main sequence.”
Abstract: “However, their star formation rates \textit{are} significantly lower ($\sim0.5-1$ dex) than the peak star formation rates inferred from spectrophotometric fitting.”

Abstract: “We propose that the CO luminous post-starburst phase represents the last gasp of star formation in galaxies on the rapid quenching pathway, and that dust-obscured star formation, outflows, and (speculatively) an uncertain CO-to-H2 conversion reconcile their gas exhaustion with observed timescales of fading.”
analysis.research_progress: 用空间分辨的近红外氢复合线约束三个高 CO 光度后星暴星系的尘埃校正恒星形成率，显示它们并非完全宁静，而是仍活跃但相较推断峰值显著下降的恒星形成系统。

analysis.result: 除淬灭时间超过 260 Myr 的星系叠加谱外，其余叠加谱均呈现指示外流的谱线质心蓝移。外流速度随淬灭后时间增加而下降，与其他星系性质关联较弱。推断的质量负载因子为 1–120，最大速度超过宿主星系星际介质的逃逸速度，能量与动量通量超过当前恒星形成所能提供的预期值。作者认为这些外流可能是既往星暴或 AGN 活动留下的遗迹。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 中等红移后星暴星系中冷气体外流的普遍性、性质及其与快速恒星形成淬灭的关系。
analysis.method: 利用含超过 1300 个后星暴星系的 SQuIGG$\vec{L}$E 巡天，将光谱按恒星质量、恒星形成率及比恒星形成率、星暴质量、星暴质量比例和淬灭后时间分箱叠加，以 Fe II 和 Mg II 吸收线搜寻并表征冷气体外流。
citation_leads: Abstract: “In this work, we search for and characterize cool gas outflows traced by Fe II $λλ$2586,2600 and Mg II $λλ$2796,2803 absorption in post-starburst galaxies (PSBs) at $0.5<z<0.9$, which are accessible to ground-based spectroscopy.”

Abstract: “Utilizing the SQuIGG$\vec{L}$E survey containing over 1300 PSBs, we stack spectra in bins of stellar mass, (specific) star formation rate, burst mass, burst mass fraction, and time since quenching.”
Abstract: “We observe blueshifted line centroids indicative of outflows in all stacks except the one containing galaxies that quenched more than 260 Myr ago.”
Abstract: “Outflow velocities decline with increasing time since quenching, while showing little correlation with other galaxy properties.”

Abstract: “The inferred outflows have large mass loading factors of 1 -- 120, maximum velocities above the interstellar medium escape velocities of their host galaxies, and energy and momentum fluxes exceeding those expected from the current star formation.”
Abstract: “Our results suggest that cool gas outflows are ubiquitous in intermediate-redshift PSBs and are likely relic outflows launched by previous starburst or AGN activity.”

Abstract: “These outflows have the potential to quench star formation by transporting gas into the galactic halos, consistent with outflows playing an important role in rapid quenching from intermediate to high redshift.”

analysis.method: 使用软波段 0.3–1.5 keV 与硬波段 1.5–10 keV 的观测计数率构造 HR=H/S，依据保守硬度界限相对于 HR=1 的位置标记软、硬或不确定观测；计算软硬观测比例，并在剔除不确定观测后的时间序列上计算相邻标签跨界比例 CI。对三个描述量进行 z-score 标准化和 Ward/欧氏距离层次聚类，以 silhouette 为主要选簇指标；另外开展留一与 bootstrap 检验、吸收幂律模型响应折叠、随机降采样，以及代表性低计数源的贝叶斯 Poisson 源—背景重分析。

低计数贝叶斯重分析对非负源强度与背景参数采用相互独立的均匀先验。

analysis.reason: 与研究组的高能瞬变方向存在邻近而非核心联系：论文服务于中子星并合千新星的元素识别和抛射物丰度诊断，不直接研究 FRB 环境、中心引擎、喷流或高能辐射机制。其经验谱线筛选、原子数据限制及对候选元素识别的检验，可为致密天体并合的多波段电磁对应体研究提供实用基线，值得了解。
analysis.result: 正文报告了 14 颗化学特殊星的高分辨率近红外光谱，多数样本出现 Sr II 三重线与 H 波段 Ce III 强线，并在部分恒星中检测到 Gd III、Eu II 和 Nd III。扩大样本后仍未发现系统性强于这些跃迁的未识别谱线。经验等值宽度比较表明，Eu 与 Sr 的绝对丰度近似相当时，Eu II 可与 Sr II 竞争；Nd III 要与 Ce III 强线相当，则需要 Nd 丰度约为 Ce 的 100 倍。因此，正文更支持 Sr II、Ce III 的主要作用，同时提出在重元素高度富集的并合抛射物中，Eu II、Nd III 可能参与 Sr II 附近的谱特征；这不是对千新星中这些元素的新直接确认。

analysis.problem: 重元素近红外原子数据不完整、不够准确，使千新星元素识别存在非唯一性及未知跃迁污染的可能。论文检验此前基于单颗化学特殊星提出的强跃迁重要性是否在不同大气参数和丰度模式下仍成立，并筛选其他可能影响千新星谱线的重元素跃迁。
analysis.method: 使用 Subaru/IRD 获取 9 颗 ApBp 星和 5 颗 AmFm 星的 Y、J、H 波段光谱，光谱分辨率约为 70000。屏蔽严重受地球大气吸收影响的波段，以 Gaussian 或 Voigt 轮廓测量吸收线等值宽度；将线中心与 VALD 及经过实验能级校准的镧系线表匹配，容差为 0.15 Å。用 Turbospectrum/iSpec 合成光谱辅助识别，比较强线排序及等值宽度与丰度的关系，并重新估计 Sr 丰度。
assumptions: 辅助光谱合成采用局域热动平衡和一维平面平行 ATLAS 大气模型。
化学特殊星仅作为富金属大气的代理，不作为本征核合成丰度模式的指示物。
镧系跃迁识别采用较宽松标准：波长匹配且下能级能量低于 5 eV 时，即使模型与观测不一致也可视为已识别。
limits: 原子跃迁概率及文献丰度存在系统不确定性；详细测量 Eu II、Nd III 的 gf 值和丰度超出本文范围。
地球大气吸收和仪器覆盖限制使重要 La III 跃迁无法检验，不能将其未检出解释为对千新星不重要。
化学特殊星光球比千新星更热，代理条件并不完全相同；roAp 星的表观电离程度也可能偏离均匀大气假设。

analysis.reason: 与研究组的 FRB 周围环境、传播效应及多屏散射判别直接相关。论文将前景宇宙网冷云团造成的源展宽转化为银河系闪烁抑制这一可检验信号，并讨论宿主屏混淆、观测分辨率和模型偏离，适合用于高红移 FRB 样本设计及环境约束。其研究效用在于理论预测与诊断方法，不依赖是否已有观测发现。
analysis.result: 模型认为，利用宇宙网散射屏对银河系闪烁的抑制，比直接探测宇宙网屏自身的闪烁更有希望。所给示例中，10^12 太阳质量晕内的冷且湍流云团，可通过源红移约0.5和2的 FRB 分别探测至约10^-4和10^-5的体积填充因子。片层和丝状体的有效交会及抑制比例通常低于晕，更适合用高红移样本检验。宿主屏通常不能在常见观测频率下显著抑制银河系闪烁，但存在特殊几何与银河系带宽条件下的例外。以上均为模型预测或示例，不是新的观测检测。

analysis.problem: FRB 闪烁能否探测宇宙网片层、丝状体和大质量晕 CGM 中的冷小云团与湍流电子密度起伏？如何通过银河系闪烁被抑制的频率及 FRB 比例，约束云团尺度、密度、体积填充因子和湍流，并区分前景、宿主及银河系散射屏的作用？
analysis.method: 以冷却碎裂模型作为冷云团性质的基准，结合宇宙网维里性质解析模型及椭球坍缩 excursion set 框架估算结构的交会数和 DM。采用 Kolmogorov 湍流谱计算相干尺度、时间展宽和闪烁带宽；将通量调制分解为散射强弱、探测器频率分辨率及源尺寸效应。通过比较前一屏展宽源的表观角度与后一屏的衍射角，求得银河系闪烁抑制的转折频率，再对结构质量、红移及云团覆盖概率积分，预测抑制比例及其与河外 DM 的关系。
assumptions: 以 shattering 图景作为冷云团模型基准：热不稳定大云的冷却时间远短于声穿越时间时碎裂为小云团；不将这一机制本身视为本文已验证的结论。
limits: 本文不检验 shattering 机制本身的有效性，仅将其作为探索宇宙网湍流密度起伏的基准。
不同宇宙网散射屏之间仍存在混淆，难以仅凭抑制信号区分晕、丝状体等结构。
云团尺度、非热压力贡献和湍流内尺度会改变转折频率及抑制比例；大幅增大云团尺度尤其可能削弱信号。
直接探测宇宙网屏的通量调制虽在部分条件下可行，但受多屏抑制、宿主展宽和频道分辨率等因素限制。

analysis.reason: 本文直接约束红超巨星的爆炸前周星气体，是研究II-P型超新星周星介质及后期激波相互作用的有用输入。其研究价值不只是质量损失率测量，还包括揭示紧致CO包层、空间尺度与质量损失率之间的退化，以及简化估算方法可能产生的偏差。正文综合指出，所测气体区域对应超新星爆炸后约1–3年激波到达的位置，而不是闪光光谱探测的近星区域；使用这些结果时应区分两类尺度。
analysis.result: 28颗红超巨星中有11颗检出CO J=2–1。除复杂的DFK 52外，CO发射普遍紧致或未分辨；小包层与测得风速意味着观测主要追踪约百年的质量损失。获接受的CO辐射转移模型质量损失率覆盖约10^-5.5至10^-3太阳质量/年，但存在显著参数退化，不能视为各源的唯一最佳值；正文将气体质量损失率约束解释为下限。增强的外部光解辐射不能单独解释普遍偏小的CO包层。DFK 49光度下修后仍呈现高于经验预测的强质量损失。

analysis.problem: 如何利用发射气体的空间约束，检验并可靠使用简化的质量损失率估算方法，避免包层尺度假设不适用时产生显著偏差。
analysis.method: 统一处理RSGC2新ALMA观测与RSGC1档案数据，分析CO J=2–1、毫米连续谱及RSGC2的SiO谱线；屏蔽受星际介质污染的速度通道，以经验壳层线型拟合风速和系统速度。使用RADMC-3D拟合尘埃SED，并以一维非LTE蒙特卡洛CO辐射转移模型比较不同孔径中的谱线和通量，约束质量损失率与CO半丰度半径；另测试增强辐射场下的CO光解模型。
limits: CO观测普遍受到显著的星际介质污染，需要剔除受污染通道。
缺失速度通道使膨胀速度与系统速度产生退化；相关拟合误差可达1–3 km/s，仅有CO的部分源误差为2–6 km/s。
CO未探测源对质量损失率处方提供的额外约束有限，不能仅凭未探测确定低质量损失率。
没有模型能同时重现DFK 1最内侧两个孔径的观测。

analysis.result: 在模拟测试集合中，联合半径和潮汐形变输入通常优于单通道输入；中档噪声下，稳定恒星可达密度范围内的压力误差由仅半径输入的6.7%降至5.4%。声速平方重建误差随观测数量增加而下降，收益递减但未见饱和。结论报告名义2σ区间覆盖约95%–97%的密度点，不确定度在稳定恒星无法探测的密度区域增大。按紧致度而非质量分组，压力与声速测试集合中的中心密度散布分别由0.090降至0.064 fm⁻³、由0.083降至0.061 fm⁻³。

analysis.problem: 如何由有限且带噪声的中子星质量、半径和潮汐形变观测集合，重建冷致密物质的压力或声速平方随密度的变化，同时评估预测不确定性、观测数量需求及不同恒星对不同密度的约束作用。
analysis.method: 采用置换不变、支持可变大小输入集合的Set Transformer，在0.10–1.10 fm⁻³的20个等距密度点预测压力或声速平方。主要模型使用异方差高斯输出头和高斯负对数似然训练；压力与声速分别使用分段多方和高斯过程状态方程集合生成模拟观测。比较半径、潮汐形变及联合输入、不同噪声和观测数量，并用输出对观测量的Jacobian分析密度敏感性，以紧致度检验跨状态方程的对应关系。

声速敏感性图的波状结构继承自高斯过程训练集合，不应解释为网络独立发现的物理结构。

must_read.text: 谱峰附近由 X 模主导，保持接近 100% 的线偏振及近恒定偏振角；离轴及高频处 O 模贡献增强，可产生圆偏振和偏振角变化，但球面积分后仍以线偏振为主。

must_read.label: Tracing the Host-Galaxy Environments of FRBs with a New Sample of Localized Sources Detected with the DSA-110
must_read.text: 43个已知红移的DSA-110定位FRB的宿主DM中位数约241–242 pc cm⁻³。

must_read.text: 模型认为，利用宇宙网散射屏对银河系闪烁的抑制，比直接探测宇宙网屏自身的闪烁更有希望。

must_read.label: The Molecular Circumstellar Environments of Red Supergiants in Galactic Open Clusters
must_read.text: 28颗红超巨星中有11颗检出CO J=2–1。

opening_brief.worth_knowing_summary: 8颗没有明亮伴星光谱特征的氦星中，5颗检出符合双星运动的显著径向速度变化，3颗未检出。；MDN 在所用核素数据上的整体 RMSE 为 0.597。 等。
